name: Sandbox is turned off for the workspace
description: The insecure_none sandbox type disables Cursor's sandbox entirely, so agent-run commands reach the whole machine instead of the workspace, whichever configuration source declared it.
message: The sandbox is disabled, so agent-run commands are unconfined

name: Sandbox write access is granted by an absolute or home path
description: additionalReadwritePaths lists extra paths the agent may read and write, on top of the workspace the workspace_readwrite type grants by default. An entry spelled absolutely or under the home directory asks for reach the default grant does not carry, and it is committed configuration rather than a prompt the user answers. A workspace-relative entry names what the default type already covers, so it is left out.
message: additionalReadwritePaths grants write access by an absolute or home path rather than a workspace-relative one

name: Sandbox read access is granted by an absolute or home path
description: additionalReadonlyPaths lists extra paths the agent may read, on top of the workspace the default sandbox type already covers. Reading is enough to stage an exfiltration: a credential file the agent can read is a credential it can put in a command it runs. The path decides nothing about which secrets sit behind it, so this rule takes the same absolute-or-home spelling its writable-path sibling takes, and a reader judges the destination. A workspace-relative entry adds no reach to report.
message: additionalReadonlyPaths grants read access by an absolute or home path rather than a workspace-relative one

name: Sandbox egress allows whatever no pattern matches
description: The fallback decides what happens to traffic no allow or deny pattern matched. The allow value flips it from a denial to an acceptance, so every host nobody thought to deny becomes reachable, whichever configuration source set it.
message: Sandbox egress allows any host no pattern matched

name: Sandbox egress is opened to a pattern
description: A networkPolicy.allow entry is a host the sandboxed agent may reach: an exact host, a wildcard covering every subdomain of a domain, or a CIDR block. Matching ignores the URL path, so the whole host is reachable however narrow the entry reads.
message: Sandbox egress is opened to this host pattern
